Classification networks output raw score.zh: 分类网络输出的是原始分数。Softmax 将其转化为概率分布；交叉熵衡量模型对真实答案的惊讶程度；而最美妙之处在于——训练网络的梯度恰好就是@@T0@@预测值减去目标值@@T1@@，即 $p - y$。拖动下方的 logit，观察这三者如何一同变化。
Classification networks output raw score.src: Classification networks output raw scores. Softmax turns them into a probability distribution; cross-entropy scores how surprised the model is by the true answer; and — the beautiful part — the gradient that trains the network turns out to be exactly predicted minus target, $p - y$. Slide the logits below and watch all three move together.

@@T0@@约 9 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 损失函数 · 分类@@T3@@

For a $K$-class problem the network emit.zh: 对于一个 $K$ 类问题，网络输出 logit $z_1,\dots,z_K$。带温度 $T$ 的 softmax 将其映射为概率，交叉熵对 one-hot 目标 $y$ 读出损失，而对 logit 的梯度则出人意料地简洁：
For a $K$-class problem the network emit.src:
For a $K$-class problem the network emits logits $z_1,\dots,z_K$. Softmax with
      temperature $T$ maps them to probabilities, cross-entropy reads off the loss for
      a one-hot target $y$, and the gradient with respect to the logits is startlingly clean:

That last identity is why softmax + cros.zh: 正是最后的这个恒等式，使 softmax + 交叉熵成为深度学习中的默认搭配：繁琐的链式法则尽数消去，只剩下「每个类错得有多离谱，带符号」。下方的组件完全围绕这三个公式构建。
That last identity is why softmax + cros.src:
That last identity is why softmax + cross-entropy is the default pairing in
      deep learning: no messy chain rule survives, just “how wrong is each
      class, signed.” The widget below is built entirely around these three formulas.

Logits in, loss and gradient out.zh: 输入 logit，输出损失与梯度
Logits in, loss and gradient out.src: Logits in, loss and gradient out

Three classes. Set the logits, choose wh.zh: 三个类别。设定各 logit，选择哪一个类别才是真正正确的，并可选地通过温度加以锐化或平坦化。左侧面板是 softmax 分布（真实类别以轮廓标出）；右侧面板是梯度 $p - y$，即每个 logit 在反向传播中所受到的有符号作用力。
Three classes. Set the logits, choose wh.src:
Three classes. Set the logits, choose which class is actually correct, and
      optionally sharpen or flatten with temperature. The left panel is the softmax
      distribution (the true class outlined); the right panel is the gradient
      $p - y$, the signed force each logit feels during backprop.

Softmax probabilities $p_k$. The outline.zh: Softmax 概率 $p_k$。带轮廓的柱为真实类别；其高度即 $p_{\text{true}}$。
Softmax probabilities $p_k$. The outline.src: Softmax probabilities $p_k$. The outlined bar is the true class; its height is $p_{\text{true}}$.

Gradient $p_k - y_k$. Bars above zero ge.zh: 梯度 $p_k - y_k$。高于零的柱被@@T0@@下压@@T1@@；低于零的柱（真实类别）被@@T2@@上推@@T3@@。
Gradient $p_k - y_k$. Bars above zero ge.src: Gradient $p_k - y_k$. Bars above zero get pushed down; the bar below zero (true class) gets pushed up.

@@T0@@Probability of true class@@T1@@\n.src: Probability of true class —

@@T0@@Click through the four presets.@@T.zh: @@T0@@依次点击四个预设。@@T1@@留意那个醒目的损失数值。@@T2@@正确且自信@@T3@@时它接近零。@@T4@@错误且自信@@T5@@时它极为巨大——又确信又出错是分类器所能做的最昂贵的一件事，因为当 $p_{\text{true}} \to 0$ 时 $-\log p_{\text{true}} \to \infty$。真实类别上的梯度柱也会向 $-1$ 增长：这是纠正错误所能施加的最强推力。
@@T0@@Click through the four presets.@@T.src: Click through the four presets. Watch the big loss number. Correct & confident is nearly zero. Wrong & confident is huge — being sure and wrong is the single most expensive thing a classifier can do, because $-\log p_{\text{true}} \to \infty$ as $p_{\text{true}} \to 0$. The gradient bar on the true class also grows toward $-1$: the strongest possible push to fix the mistake.

Why the gradient is just $p - y$.src: Why the gradient is just $p - y$

Cross-entropy looks like it should have.zh: 交叉熵看上去应当有一个丑陋的导数——其中有一个 $\log$，而 softmax 内部还有一个 $\sum$。但 $\log$ 与 $\exp$ 几乎完美地相互抵消。对真实类别 $y$：
Cross-entropy looks like it should have.src:
Cross-entropy looks like it should have an ugly derivative — there is a
      $\log$, and a $\sum$ inside the softmax. But the $\log$ and the $\exp$ cancel
      almost perfectly. For the true class $y$:

For a @@T0@@non-true@@T1@@ class, $y_k =.zh: 对于@@T0@@非真实@@T1@@类别，$y_k = 0$，故梯度为 $+p_k$——按其错误占有的概率比例@@T2@@下压@@T3@@该 logit。
For a @@T0@@non-true@@T1@@ class, $y_k =.src: For a non-true class, $y_k = 0$, so the gradient is $+p_k$ — push that logit down in proportion to how much probability it wrongly claimed.

For the @@T0@@true@@T1@@ class, $y_k = 1.zh: 对于@@T0@@真实@@T1@@类别，$y_k = 1$，故梯度为 $p_{\text{true}} - 1 \le 0$——@@T2@@上推@@T3@@该 logit，且当 $p_{\text{true}}$ 越小时推力越强。
For the @@T0@@true@@T1@@ class, $y_k = 1.src: For the true class, $y_k = 1$, so the gradient is $p_{\text{true}} - 1 \le 0$ — push that logit up, hardest when $p_{\text{true}}$ is small.

The gradients sum to zero: probability t.zh: 各梯度之和为零：从错误类别流出的概率流入正确类别。Softmax 使其守恒。
The gradients sum to zero: probability t.src: The gradients sum to zero: probability that leaves the wrong classes flows into the right one. Softmax conserves it.

@@T0@@Practical note.@@T1@@ Because the.zh: @@T0@@实用提示。@@T1@@由于梯度为 $p - y$，各框架将 softmax 与交叉熵融合为单个算子（PyTorch 的 @@T2@@CrossEntropyLoss@@T3@@ 接收原始 logit，而非概率）。若你自己先做 softmax 再接一个单独的交叉熵，便会重复计算，产生错误且不稳定的梯度。请直接输入 logit，让损失函数去完成 softmax。
@@T0@@Practical note.@@T1@@ Because the.src: Practical note. Because the gradient is $p - y$, frameworks fuse softmax and cross-entropy into a single op (PyTorch's CrossEntropyLoss takes raw logits, not probabilities). Applying softmax yourself and then a separate cross-entropy double-counts and gives wrong, unstable gradients. Feed logits; let the loss do the softmax.

meta.title: Softmax 与交叉熵
meta.tagline: 将 logit 转化为概率，读出损失，观察梯度如何变成 p 减去 y
meta.summary: 拖动三个 logit，选择真实类别，再转动温度旋钮。观察 softmax 概率、作为一个醒目数值的交叉熵损失 -log(p_true)，以及作为带符号柱状图的反向传播梯度 p - y。四个预设——从自信且正确到自信却错误——使结论一目了然：损失对自信的错误惩罚最重，而纠正它们的梯度恰是预测值减去目标值。
highlights: 实时观察 softmax 将三个 logit 映射到概率单纯形上，真实类别高亮显示。
将交叉熵损失 -log(p_true) 作为一个醒目数值读出，切身感受它随真实类别概率下降而爆炸的速度。
看清损失对 logit 的梯度恰为 p - y，以带符号的上推 / 下压柱形绘制。
四个一键预设对比「正确且自信」与「自信却错误」的惨重代价。
温度旋钮可锐化或平坦化分布，使你能够将本页与蒸馏和校准联系起来。
